presets.name: Telephone Choir
presets.note: The renderer reported 3 of its notes started late on the emulated card (unison: 9 voices per chord note); not audible here.

presets.name: Bowl Swell
presets.note: The singing_bowl_c layers are very quiet: about -48 LUFS before the demo's normalizing.

presets.name: Vibe Wide
presets.hot: hot: peaks at +0.4 dBFS (float output, 9 samples over full scale)

presets.name: Cello Breath
presets.hot: hot: peaks at +1.3 dBFS (float output, 232 samples over full scale)

presets.name: Organ Ring
presets.hot: hot: peaks at +1.5 dBFS (float output, 252 samples over full scale)

presets.name: Echo Count
presets.hot: hot: peaks at +0.7 dBFS (float output, 60 samples over full scale)
presets.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders. In this offline render the chords that land during each rebuild (at 3 s and 5 s) are dropped.

presets.name: Critical Bass
presets.note: critstop is an XP sound, so 3.11 plays DING. Slowed four times by <<, DING's short lead-in becomes about 0.4 s of silence, so short notes end before they sound.

presets.name: Hardware Sub
presets.note: hwin and hwout are XP sounds, so 3.11 plays DING. Slowed four times by <<, its lead-in becomes about 0.4 s of silence, so short notes end before they sound.

presets.name: Chord Thump
presets.note: Silent on Windows 3.11: after << the position is at the start, so ] (Delete After Current Position) deletes the whole sound and the layer is empty.

presets.name: Kit
presets.hot: hot: peaks at +0.6 dBFS (float output, 16 samples over full scale)

presets.name: Macro Echoes
presets.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders. In this offline render the chords that land as each rebuild starts (at 2 s and 4 s) are dropped.
